comparison.objective: Replace a ratchet dispenser cartridge and re-engage its piston rod; candidate transfers a bearing block between a rail and jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record disengages/retracts a piston, exchanges cartridges and restores a ratchet mechanism. Candidate maintains flush parallel supports while sliding an uncaged bearing block.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires used-cartridge collection, replacement seating, rod re-engagement, dispenser placement and release. Candidate requires full transfer with every ball retained and no support gap, jam or damage.
comparison.reason: Consumable exchange and ratchet restoration do not exercise rolling-element containment across an aligned support junction.
